Q: Does malloc failure imply ENOMEM? A:

If I run malloc and it fails and returns NULL, can I assume that errno is set to ENOMEM?

Strictly speaking, the answer is no. The Linux man page says “NULL may also be returned by a successful call to malloc() with a size of zero,” and I would not consider that an error, so I would not expect ENOMEM to be set. The POSIX documentation also allows a null pointer to be returned for a zero-size request and says that errno is then set to an implementation-defined value, so that could be zero.

For requests of a non-zero size, then the answer is yes for POSIX systems. In the case of a non-zero size, the POSIX documentation allows returning a null pointer only iff errno is set.

Q: How to remove characters from the beginning of a string in SQL? A:

Per the MySQL documentation, the function you are looking for is SUBSTR() and the operation to modify a table is UPDATE. You can use the SUBSTR() function in your WHERE clause to find rows that match your criteria:

UPDATE your_members_table 
SET member_name = SUBSTR(member_name, 4) --drops first 3 characters
WHERE SUBSTR(member_name, 1, 3) = "RDx"

Good luck!

Edit: Add UPPER() or LOWER() for case-insensitivity:

WHERE UPPER(SUBSTR(member_name, 1, 3)) = "RDX"

Q: edit meta comment tag of an mkv file A:

You can use ffmpeg to add a comment or other metadata to an .mkv file, so you don't need to first create an XML file.

The disadvantage is that it doesn't add the comment to an existing file, but creates a copy of the file with the added comment and/or other metadata. But video, audio, subtitles etc are copied without re-encoding.

Example (using variables):

ffmpeg -i "$my_mkv_in" -c copy -map 0 -metadata title="$My_Title" -metadata artist="$Artist" -metadata comment="$Comment" "$mkv_new"

Q: In SSMS, how do I change a SQL query window's tab name? A:

Here in 2026 in SSMS 2022 we can find the Tab names user Tools/Options/Text Editor/More Settings then find the Editor Tab and Status Bar link for the dialog. At the end we can change the tab text to our liking preference. Here I just show the file name, nothing else.

Q: Run angular Karma tests in visual studio code A:

Seeing your package.json, it seems that you are using an older version of Angular CLI (^1.7.4) and not the newer Angular CLI version that uses angular.json for configuration.

Try this:

  • Uninstall test explorer.
  • Update Angular CLI.
  • Reinstall test explorer.

Q: How do I keep a socket io ID while using changing html files? A:

it's basically impossible as explained in this stackoverflow post:

how to handle page reload in socket.io client chat applications

However, as mentioned in above answer you could either:

  • move the socketio connection script in index.html file
  • Handle the disconnect event on the server-side (unregister/delete user) so that it get naturally re-registered when index.html page reload
  • Store in Local/Session storage some ID that you save in your DB to relate to your user.
